content: runs.target_branch (sqlite migration 0027_quick_wind_dancer, postgres migration 0021_fine_justin_hammer, warren-1f81 / #419) is a nullable text column persisting the operator-requested target branch at dispatch (Option B), added after pr_url in both schema/sqlite.ts and schema/postgres.ts. CreateRunInput gains targetBranch?: string|null; create() sets targetBranch: input.targetBranch ?? null. After bun run db:generate, the drizzle-generated meta/*.json snapshots + _journal.json must be biome-formatted (bunx biome format --write) or the lint gate fails.

sqlite migration 0030_moaning_tombstone, postgres 0024_perfect_proteus. Drop order is messages-then-conversations (child before parent FK). Postgres uses DROP TABLE ... CASCADE, which supersedes the RLS enabled by pg 0020_enable_rls_conversations_messages. CONVERSATION_STATES/MESSAGE_ROLES enums + TABLE_NAMES.conversations/messages + INDEX_NAMES.conversations*/messages* entries removed from src/db/schema/columns.ts; sqlite.ts + postgres.ts tables and Conversation/Message Row/Insert types removed; drift.test.ts TABLE_KEYS parity list updated. Companion test: src/db/migrations/drop-conversations-tables.test.ts. Note: drizzle-kit regenerates _journal.json with 2-space indent, so run biome format --write on the meta JSON after db:generate.

warren-0b13 / pl-3a79 step 9 dropped the plot DB surface: plots table, runs.plot_id, plan_runs.plot_id, projects.has_plot + indexes (runs_plot_id_idx, plan_runs_plot_id_idx, plots_*) in both dialects. Forward drop migrations: sqlite 0031_normal_johnny_blaze, postgres 0025_black_santa_claus. Removed PlotProjectionState from columns.ts. Cascaded removal of RunsRepo.listByPlotId + listByPlotId query, cost-analytics 'plot' Dimension, and the events NDJSON plotId envelope tag (eventToNdjson signature lost its plotId param). Note: drizzle-kit generate needs node_modules resolvable from src/db/schema/ — in the burrow sandbox node_modules lives at /app so symlink /app/node_modules into the workspace root before running bun run db:generate.
